legal.pageTitle: Terms and Conditions of Service (SaaS Agreement)
legal.acceptLabel: I have read and agree to the
legal.section1Title: Scope and Purpose of the SaaS Service
legal.section1Text: NextHappen is a digital SaaS platform operated by Festora, facilitating the discovery, management, and promotion of cultural, culinary, and design fairs in Lima.
legal.section1Full: NextHappen, developed by Festora, is a Software as a Service (SaaS) web platform engineered to connect attendees, cultural collectives, and fair organizers within Lima Metropolitana. The platform provides real-time event discovery, stand allocation, and ticketing administration, maintaining high standards of software quality and accessibility.
legal.section2Text: Users agree to provide true and verified information during registration and keep their access credentials secure and confidential.
legal.section2Full: All registered attendees and organizers must ensure the integrity and veracity of their identity and published events. Users are strictly responsible for preserving the confidentiality of their credentials and two-factor authentication tokens. Misuse, identity impersonation, or unauthorized access attempts will result in account termination.
legal.section3Title: SaaS Agreement, Event Publishing, and Ticketing
legal.section3Text: Organizers are fully responsible for fair scheduling, accurate capacity limits, and attendee communication.
legal.section3Full: Organizers utilize NextHappen under a Software-as-a-Service model to publish fairs, manage booths, and facilitate event entrance. Organizers must adhere to true capacity limits (50-600 attendees) and promptly notify registered users of any logistics change or postponement through the notification service.
legal.section4Text: Festora strictly complies with personal data protection regulations. User data is never commercialized to third parties.
legal.section4Full: In alignment with international data privacy standards and the Peruvian Personal Data Protection Law (Law 29733), NextHappen safeguards all user details, ticket transactions, and preference metrics using encryption and strict access policies. User data is collected solely for service fulfillment and continuous platform improvement.
legal.section5Title: Professional Software Engineering Ethics (ACM/IEEE and CIP)
legal.section5Text: The system is built and maintained following the ethical codes of ACM/IEEE and the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP).
legal.section5Full: In adherence to Student Outcome 4 and the Joint ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics as well as the CIP Code of Ethics, the engineering team prioritizes public interest, user safety, algorithmic fairness, and transparency. The platform avoids manipulative design patterns, ensures digital accessibility (a11y), and commits to prompt vulnerability mitigation.
legal.section6Title: Limitation of Liability and Dispute Resolution
legal.section6Text: Festora acts as an enabling technology provider. Disputes concerning independent fair operations will be mediated in good faith.
legal.section6Full: NextHappen operates as a technology facilitator for independent fairs. While Festora rigorously monitors platform integrity, independent event organizers retain direct responsibility for venue safety and physical execution. Any dispute shall first undergo an amicable mediation process in accordance with local regulations in Lima, Peru.
